42125-armorel-of-lyonesse-a-romance-of-t.title: A Romance of To-day
42125-armorel-of-lyonesse-a-romance-of-t.creator: Unknown
42125-armorel-of-lyonesse-a-romance-of-t.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It was the evening of a fine September day. Through the square window, built out so as to form another room almost as large as that which had been thus enlarged, the autumn sun, now fast declining to the west, poured in warm and strong; but not too warm or too strong for the girl on whose head it fell as she sat leaning back in the low chair, her face turned towards the window.

appletons-cyclopaedia-american-biography.description: Appletons' Cyclopaedia of American Biography, vol. 6 (Sunderland–Zurita, 1889) — 15,000+ lives of notable Americans, with the general index to all six volumes.

arxiv-2112-03378.title: Differentiable Generalised Predictive Coding
arxiv-2112-03378.creator: Andre Ofner, Sebastian Stober
arxiv-2112-03378.description: Abstract This paper deals with differentiable dynamical models congruent with neural process theories that cast brain function as the hierarchical refinement of an internal generative model explaining observations. Our work extends existing implementations of gradient-based predictive coding with automatic differentiation and allows to integrate deep neural networks for non-linear state parameterization.

arxiv-2203-10890.title: Testing black holes in non-linear electrodynamics from the observed quasi-periodic oscillations
arxiv-2203-10890.creator: Indrani Banerjee
arxiv-2203-10890.description: Abstract Quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs), in particular, the ones with high frequencies, often observed in the power spectrum of black holes, are useful in understanding the nature of strong gravity since they are associated with the motion of matter in the vicinity of the black hole horizon.

arxiv-2302-00594.title: Inching Towards Automated Understanding of the Meaning of Art: An Application to Computational Analysis of Mondrian’s Artwork
arxiv-2302-00594.creator: Alex Doboli, Mahan Agha Zahedi, Niloofar Gholamrezaei
arxiv-2302-00594.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alex Doboli, Mahan Agha Zahedi, Niloofar Gholamrezaei. Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have been successfully used in classifying digital images but have been less succesful in classifying images with meanings that are not linear combinations of their visualized features, like images of artwork. Moreover, it is unknown what additional features must be included into DNNs, so that they can possibly classify using features beyond visually displayed features, like color, size, and form.

arxiv-2308-03526.title: AlphaStar Unplugged: Large-Scale Offline Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2308-03526.creator: Michaël Mathieu, Sherjil Ozair, Srivatsan Srinivasan, Caglar Gulcehre, Shangtong Zhang, Ray Jiang, Tom Le Paine, Richard Powell, Konrad Żołna, Julian Schrittwieser, David Choi, Petko Georgiev, Daniel Toyama, Aja Huang, Roman Ring, Igor Babuschkin, Timo Ewalds, Mahyar Bordbar, Sarah Henderson, Sergio
arxiv-2308-03526.description: Abstract StarCraft II is one of the most challenging simulated reinforcement learning environments; it is partially observable, stochastic, multi-agent, and mastering StarCraft II requires strategic planning over long time horizons with real-time low-level execution. It also has an active professional competitive scene.

arxiv-2311-15493.title: UFIN: Universal Feature Interaction Network for Multi-Domain Click-Through Rate Prediction
arxiv-2311-15493.creator: Zhen Tian, Changwang Zhang, Wayne Xin Zhao, Xin Zhao, Ji-Rong Wen, Zhao Cao
arxiv-2311-15493.description: Abstract Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction, which aims to estimate the probability of a user clicking on an item, is a key task in online advertising. Numerous existing CTR models concentrate on modeling the feature interactions within a solitary domain, thereby rendering them inadequate for fulfilling the requisites of multi-domain recommendations in real industrial scenarios.

arxiv-2412-10577.title: Lanes and lattice structures in a repulsive model for self-propelled agents
arxiv-2412-10577.creator: P. Bisht
arxiv-2412-10577.description: Abstract We investigate a simple Vicsek-type rule-based model for self-propelled particles, where each particle orients itself antiparallel to the average orientation of particles within a defined neighborhood of radius R R . The particle orientation is updated asynchronously and randomly across the system.

arxiv-2507-13531.title: Methodological considerations for semialgebraic hypothesis testing with incomplete U-statistics Thanks: All authors contributed to the initial conception and planning of this project and approved the final manuscript. MG-L and MH developed the final code for implementing the SDL method and conductin
arxiv-2507-13531.creator: David Barnhill, Marina Garrote-López, Elizabeth Gross, Max Hill, Bryson Kagy, John A. Rhodes, Joy Z. Zhang
arxiv-2507-13531.description: Abstract . Recently, Sturma, Drton, and Leung proposed a general-purpose stochastic method for hypothesis testing in models defined by polynomial equality and inequality constraints. Notably, the method remains theoretically valid even near irregular points, such as singularities and boundaries, where traditional testing approaches often break down.

arxiv-2601-02860.title: Morse index of min–max stationary integral varifolds
arxiv-2601-02860.creator: Mitchell Gaudet, Talant Talipov
arxiv-2601-02860.description: Abstract We prove an upper bound for the Morse index of min–max stationary integral varifolds realizing the d d -dimensional p p -width of a closed Riemannian manifold. 1 Introduction Let (M^{n},g) be a closed Riemannian manifold. The d -dimensional volume spectrum is the sequence of invariants \{\omega_{p}^{d}(M,g)\}_{p\in\mathbb{N}} introduced by Gromov [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] .

arxiv-2601-19943.title: Emergent Specialization in Learner Populations: Competition as the Source of Diversity
arxiv-2601-19943.creator: Yuhao Li
arxiv-2601-19943.description: Abstract How can populations of learners develop coordinated, diverse behaviors without explicit communication or diversity incentives? We demonstrate that competition alone is sufficient to induce emergent specialization—learners spontaneously partition into specialists for different environmental regimes through competitive dynamics, consistent with ecological niche theory. We introduce the NichePopulation algorithm, a simple mechanism combining competitive exclusion with niche affinity tracking.

pmc-11516473.title: Difference in long COVID prevalence due to different definitions and long COVID related risk factors
pmc-11516473.creator: J Coste, C Delpierre, S Tebeka, C Lemogne, O Robineau, O Steichen, M Rushyizekera, M van den Akker, T T Makovski
pmc-11516473.description: Several definitions of long COVID are used in research and practice what challenges epidemiological investigations. Here we present differences in long COVID prevalence accounting for several definitions and concordance between the definitions, as well as the risk factors associated with long COVID.

pmc-11545833.title: Antimicrobial Efficacy of GS-2 on Reusable Food Packaging Materials for Specialty Crops
pmc-11545833.creator: Catherine W Y Wong, Thomas Burton, Julio Carrera Montoya, Nupoor Birje, Xinyi Zhou, Joelle K Salazar, Jason M Mackenzie, Thomas F Rau, Max Teplitski, Wei Zhang, Ivana Generalić Mekinić, Xiaonan Lu
pmc-11545833.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The European Union (EU) regulations mandate 10% of all food packaging to be reusable by 2030. United States (U.S.) exporters of specialty crops face new challenges in ensuring microbiological food safety using reusable packaging. A novel antimicrobial formulation consisting of ammonium carboxylate salt of capric acid and L-arginine (GS-2) was recently developed as a spray coating chemical for food packaging materials.

pmc-11737463.title: Clinical Diagnoses and Characterization of Patients With Amyloid-Negative Amyloid-Beta, p-Tau, and Neurofilament Light Chain (ATN) Profiles
pmc-11737463.creator: Colin Barnett, Kiel Morris, Yogesh Shah
pmc-11737463.description: The novel amyloid-beta, p-Tau, and neurofilament light chain (ATN) classification scheme has become a promising system for clinically detecting and diagnosing Alzheimer's disease (AD). In addition to its utility in Alzheimer's diagnosis and treatment, the ATN framework may also have clinical relevance in identifying non-Alzheimer's pathologies.

pmc-12468205.title: Spinal Metastasis from Supratentorial Glioblastoma: A Registry-Based Case Series and a Review of the Literature
pmc-12468205.creator: Arthur Chak Kai Lau, Desiree Ka-ka Wong, Justin Chun Him Cheung, Candice H. W. Lam, Myron Chak Him Wong, Jason Chak Yan Li, Danny T. M. Chan, Herbert H. F. Loong, Michael W. Y. Lee, Tony K. T. Chan, Jason M. K. Ho, Ka-Man Cheung, Teresa P. K. Tse, Joyce S. W. Chow, Aya El-Helali, Peter Y. M. Woo
pmc-12468205.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryGlioblastoma is the most common primary brain malignancy among adults and carries a poor prognosis. In rare circumstances, glioblastoma can metastasize to the spinal cord, resulting in severe focal neurological deficits, including paralysis and incontinence. We report the clinical presentation, treatment, and outcomes of 15 patients with this rare phenomenon, identified from a territory-wide brain tumor registry in Hong Kong. Treatment for glioblastoma spinal metastasis may include a combination of spinal surgery, radiotherapy, and/or systemic therapies.

pmc-13138268.title: Level of Emergency Preparedness and Associated Barriers at the Accident and Emergency Ward of a LMIC Hospital: A Cross-Sectional Assessment Using the WHO HEAT Tool
pmc-13138268.creator: Joel Nabeshya, Elizabeth Atiang, Charity Kwarikunda, Rachel Luwaga, Vallence Niyonzima
pmc-13138268.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundEmergency preparedness is a challenge for hospital emergency departments (EDs). In the USA, over 68% of 983 EDs were not emergency prepared, while in Ghana, one hospital’s emergency preparedness level was only 57.4%.

pmc-13204662.title: MEOX1 Inhibits Growth and Metastasis of Salivary Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma
pmc-13204662.creator: Huaxiu Sun, Yuping Liu, Yajuan Cui, Zheng Zhou, Zhanlan Wu, Chuan-Xiang Zhou
pmc-13204662.description: Salivary adenoid cystic carcinoma (SACC) is a malignant salivary gland neoplasm characterized by aggressive local invasion and a marked propensity for metastasis. However, the role of MEOX1 in SACC progression remains poorly defined. In this study, we examined the effects of MEOX1 overexpression on the malignant behavior of SACC cells in vitro and in vivo.

pmc-13209144.title: Efficacy and Safety of TACE-HAIC Combined with Molecular Targeted Therapy and Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors for Unresectable Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-13209144.creator: Zhipeng Feng, Xiaolong Wang, Junming Xu, Shiguang Chen, Mingzhi Hao, Hong Hu, Shixiang Qiu, Yunguo Liao, Wenchang Yu, Zhuting Fang
pmc-13209144.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeTo evaluate the efficacy and safety of a quadruple regimen of transarterial chemoembolization (TACE)-hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy (HAIC) plus molecular targeted therapy (MTT) and immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (uHCC).Patients and Methods274 uHCC patients were divided into two groups based on two treatment methods:TACE-HAIC combined with MTT and ICIs (THTI) and TACE combined with MTT and ICIs (TTI). The primary endpoints were progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS).

pmc-13633736.title: Painless Thoracic Herpes Zoster Eruption in an 88-Year-Old Woman With Advanced Chronic Kidney Disease: A Case Report
pmc-13633736.creator: Yasser Bouabdella
pmc-13633736.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Herpes zoster (HZ) typically presents with a unilateral vesicular eruption accompanied by neuropathic pain. Although pain is a characteristic feature, painless presentations may occur and can create a diagnostic challenge. We report the case of an 88-year-old woman with advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD) who developed a unilateral vesicular eruption involving the right thoracic dermatome without pain at any stage of the disease. She was not receiving immunosuppressive therapy and had no known diabetes mellitus, previous HZ, or neurological disorder.
